items.title: Marine Biodiversity Conservation Center "Aquarium Boka"
items.excerpt: Discover Aquarium Boka in Kotor, Montenegro’s first public aquarium, where marine research, education, and conservation come together to showcase Adriatic biodiversity and inspire protection of our seas. I was the Project Manager from 2017 to 2020.
